title: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of Translate slides in PowerPoint Live
summary: Starting November 30, 2026, the Translate slides feature in PowerPoint Live during Microsoft Teams meetings will be retired worldwide. Attendees will no longer translate slides; slides will display in their original language. No admin action is needed, but organizations should notify users and update related training materials.
body:
[What and why]

Starting November 30, 2026, attendees in Microsoft Teams meetings will no longer be able to translate slides into another language in PowerPoint Live by using Change view > Translate slides. Other PowerPoint Live features for presenters and attendees are not affected.

[Rollout schedule]

- Retirement (Worldwide): Beginning and completing in late November 2026- Translate slides will be removed for all attendees on November 30, 2026

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Attendees who use Translate slides in PowerPoint Live during Microsoft Teams meetingsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft Teams meetings- PowerPoint LiveWhat will happen

- Attendees will no longer see the Translate slides option in PowerPoint Live under Change view > Translate slides.- Attendees will see slides in the language in which they were created.- Presenting with PowerPoint Live and other attendee viewing options are not affected.- There is no admin setting to manage this change.- No admin action is required.- Most organizations will see little impact because only a very small share of PowerPoint Live sessions use this option.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required to prepare for this change. Translate slides will be removed automatically for all attendees on November 30, 2026.

We recommend that you:

- Notify presenters and users in your organization about this change, especially teams that present to audiences who speak different languages.- Ask presenters to share slides in the languages their audiences need ahead of time.- Update internal training or help content that mentions Translate slides in PowerPoint Live.

[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
